basic_profile.bio: Based in Seattle, I'm a 39-year-old software developer with a passion for personal fitness and quirky internet humor. I spend my workdays coding and my evenings either at the gym or exploring new indie games. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to travel and pursue my hobbies. I usually browse Reddit during my lunch break and late at night, often while enjoying a good craft beer.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and nearly two decades of industry experience, I've honed my skills in software development through both formal education and continuous self-learning. I've also developed a keen interest in fitness and wellness through years of gym workouts and online research.
